fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is not justified by sparse-recovery bounds because soundness must cover dense signed mixed words, not merely K-sparse vectors. Exhausting z in [-2,2]^64 neither has a stated feasible enumeration method nor bounds untested integer coefficients, and the direct integer lift lacks the exact binary-transfer identity.

Proposal 2 has no asymptotic parameter family or soundness theorem; fixed w=3,s=2 can provide only finite evidence. Its current label derivation and F4-to-binary realization are underspecified and must be frozen before implementation.

Proposal 3 does not specify the three expanders, route-selection rule, incidence matrix, or admissible reroutings. Expansion does not exclude constant-support alternating path cycles, so the proposed enumeration is not presently reproducible or tied to a valid soundness invariant.

Proposal 4 hides the hard global choice in deterministic isolation or combining splitter branches. No explicit linear lattice matrix, branch accounting, or theorem prevents signed leading-bucket cancellation, while geometric scaling can inflate the YES baseline.

Proposal 5 risks m^q tuple columns or exponential exterior dimension, and rank condensers preserve rank/nonzeroness rather than Hamming support. “Every small Guruswami–Kopparty-style map” is not a finite specified search family, and no explicit binary realization is given.

Proposal 6 is already blocked by verifier evidence: the all-eight and twisted-holonomy illegal affine words annihilate every indexed collision-walk feature. Any Hankel entry obtained by linearly aggregating those same walk products is also zero, so rank condensation cannot restore lost information.

Proposal 7 is algebraically impossible in its stated linear-chain model. If an illegal boundary is the odd sum of three legal boundaries, summing their three integral fillings is a valid filling with area at most their total area, contradicting the proposed acceptance condition and limiting separation to a constant factor.
evidence: The obstruction map leaves code-dependent dense structured tensor folds open, provided every mixed word is checked. Proposal 2 is the only candidate aimed directly at that opening with a finite-dimensional map that is not already refuted by a proved obstruction.

The prior commutative fold failed because a_i a_j=a_j a_i and produced an all-eight pointed kernel. Matrix multiplication is genuinely noncommutative, so an exact ordered-pair experiment can determine whether that specific causal failure is removed.

Existing verifiers establish that finite success cannot be promoted to asymptotic hardness. Any pass for proposal 2 would only justify designing a growing w,s family and proving mixed-word soundness and polynomial output.
The proposed hostile suite is necessary: ordinary YES/NO samples previously gave misleading positive signals while all-eight and odd-holonomy affine words canceled entire nonlinear shells.
next_experiment: Test only proposal 2. Sort each naturally labeled 3DM dictionary lexicographically and assign its kth coordinate to the kth lexicographically normalized nonzero rank-one 3x3 matrix over F4; use a fixed basis of F4 over F2 and map ordered pair (i,j) to the 18 coefficient bits of LiLj, retaining the pointed corner. Explicitly construct the resulting binary syndrome fibers and exhaust every mixed image word on ten YES, 200 NO, all-eight, twisted holonomy, and every known affine-closure witness, recording worst YES, best NO, cheapest semantically illegal hostile word, active output length, and exact-transfer rank. Kill the frozen family unless best NO and every designated illegal hostile cost exceed worst YES and log(bestNO/worstYES)/log(active length) exceeds log(25/9)/log(65); a pass remains finite evidence only.
